Problem Statement:
Given 2 numbers N,K and N arrays each of size K, print the elements that have appeared in all arrays,if any element are not same print '-1'.
input_spec: The input consists of 2 numbers N, K, and N arrays each of size K.
output_spec: Print the elements that have appeared in all arrays. If no common elements are found, print '-1'.
